text: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.
our tormentors demanded songs of joy; they said, “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”
may my right hand forget its skill.
if I do not remember you, if I do not consider Jerusalem my highest joy.
on the day Jerusalem fell. “Tear it down,” they cried, “tear it down to its foundations!”
happy is he who repays you for what you have done to us—
and dashes them against the rocks.
